docs.text: Refunds for unused prepaid hours are issued within five business days. Open a ticket with the invoice id.
The support SLA for severity-1 incidents is a first response within 15 minutes during coverage hours.
If /ready returns 503, check the vector store process, then restart the API after the store reports a document count.
Rotate RAG_API_KEY by setting the environment variable and restarting the API. Do not commit the key.
CI must not call a paid LLM judge. Frozen lexical floors are the merge gate.
A changed corpus fingerprint is CORPUS_DRIFT. Do not reuse an old baseline score.
rag-eval hidden-ask reads a categorized pack and returns a grounded extractive answer. Exit 0 is grounded, 1 is injection blocked, 2 is no match.
Other projects import HiddenRAG, call load_pack, then ask with a category. HTTP is optional.
